name: @ship/test-setup
description: Shared vitest/jsdom setup helpers: JSDOM polyfills (ResizeObserver, matchMedia, Popover, Dialog, ToggleEvent, PointerEvent) + lucide-icon-map loader. Each consumer's test/setup.ts imports from here so the polyfills + icon shape stay in lockstep — replaces ~360 lines of copy-pasted boilerplate across three test setups.
